description: Modoc County, CA – California Assemblymember Megan Dahle endorses Republican candidate Heather Hadwick for Assembly District 1. Megan Dahle has represented Northern California in the State Assembly since 2019. She joins CA State Senator and '22 Republican Gubernatorial nominee Brian Dahle in endorsing Heather's campaign. “Heather’s extensive background in public safety will enhance our rural communities and protect our way of life in the North State.
